name: jetbrains-git-tools
description: PhpStorm / IntelliJ-style Git tools: Commit tool window, Git Log with graph, Compare with Branch/Revision, History, Annotate, Branches popup, Push/Pull/Merge/Rebase dialogs, Interactive Rebase, conflict resolver, Stash and Shelf.

commands.title: Compare HEAD, Staged and Local Versions
Commit All when Nothing Is Staged
Extract Selected Changes to Separate Commit…
Extract Selected Changes to Separate Commit…
Open New Git Log Editor Tab

jbGit.gitPath.description: Path to the git executable. Empty uses `git` from PATH.

jbGit.annotate.showRevision.description: Annotations: show the short commit hash (Revision).

jbGit.annotate.names.description: Annotations: how author names are shown.

enumDescriptions: Color by commit age: recent commits are more saturated
git blame -M: lines moved or copied within the file
git blame -C: also lines moved or copied from other files of the same commit
jbGit.annotate.detectMovements.description: Annotations: detect moved or copied lines.

jbGit.annotate.preferCommitTimestamp.description: Annotations: show the commit timestamp instead of the author timestamp.

jbGit.branches.showTags.description: Branches popup: show the Tags section.

jbGit.branches.showRecent.description: Branches popup: show recently checked out branches.

jbGit.branches.groupByDirectory.description: Branches popup: group branches by their '/' prefix.

jbGit.branches.groupByRepository.description: Branches popup: show branches per repository when the workspace has several repositories.

jbGit.branches.showOnlyFavorites.description: Branches popup: show only favorite branches.

jbGit.commit.useStagingArea.markdownDescription: Use the Git staging area instead of changelists in the Commit tool window (PhpStorm: *Settings › Version Control › Git › Enable staging area*).

jbGit.cherryPick.addSuffix.description: Add the 'cherry-picked from <hash>' suffix when picking commits pushed to protected branches (jbGit.push.protectedBranches)

jbGit.commitOps.showDropCommitDialog.description: Show the confirmation dialog before Drop Commits (unset by "OK, Don't Ask Again"). Protected branches for history editing are the ones of jbGit.push.protectedBranches.

jbGit.conflicts.showNotification.description: Show a "Merge Conflicts" notification with "Resolve…" when unmerged files appear in a repository.

jbGit.diff.gutterMarkers.description: Highlight modified lines in the gutter (added, modified and deleted lines against HEAD) and in the overview ruler. Consider setting `scm.diffDecorations` to `none` to avoid duplicate markers.

enumDescriptions: Topologically: in case of merge, show incoming commits first, directly below merge commit
By Commit Date: sort commits topologically and by commit date

jbGit.log.firstParent.description: Git Log: First Parent — follow only the first parent commit upon seeing a merge commit.

jbGit.log.showLongEdges.description: Git Log: Long Edges — show long graph edges instead of cutting them behind arrows.

jbGit.log.columns.description: Git Log: visible columns in display order (subject holds the graph and references).

jbGit.log.preferCommitDate.description: Git Log: Commit Timestamp — show the time when the change was committed rather than authored.

jbGit.log.dateFormat.description: Git Log: date format pattern (yyyy, yy, MM, M, dd, d, HH, H, mm, ss). Empty uses the locale format.

jbGit.log.prettyDates.description: Git Log: show recent dates as Today / Yesterday.

jbGit.log.showTagNames.description: Git Log: Tag Names — show tag names in the table.

jbGit.log.compactReferences.description: Git Log: Compact References View — show only the first reference for a commit in the table.

jbGit.log.referencesOnLeft.description: Git Log: References on the Left — show references on the left of commit message.

jbGit.log.showDetails.description: Git Log: Show Details — commit details below the changed files.

jbGit.log.showBranches.description: Git Log: show the branches tree on the left of the log.

jbGit.push.protectedBranches.description: Protected branches (comma-separated regular expressions). Force Push to them is prohibited.

jbGit.fetch.prune.description: Prune obsolete remote-tracking references when fetching (--prune).

jbGit.update.showDialog.description: Show the Update Project dialog before updating (uncheck "Don't show this dialog again" there to bring it back).

enumDescriptions: Merge incoming changes into the current branch
Rebase the current branch on top of incoming changes
jbGit.update.method.description: Update method of Update Project and of updating after a rejected push.

enumDescriptions: Using Shelve (mapped to stash in VS Code)

editor/lineNumber/context.when: !(resourcePath in jbGit.annotate.paths) && (resourceScheme == file || resourceScheme == jbgit-rev || resourceScheme == jbgit-annotate)

scripts.vscode:prepublish: npm run contributes && npm run typecheck && npm run build
